name: web-designer-portfolio-hero-with-giant-light-sans-green-keyword-and-rotating-badge
title: Portfolio hero with a giant light headline, green 'Impact Businesses', circular 'open for projects' badge and a green-framed dark portrait
whatItIs: A pale grey page with a theme toggle and a giant faded 'PORTRAY' at the top, a white frame containing a nav with a green 'talk' pill, a huge light black headline 'Designing Products that Impact Businesses.' with the last words in green and a circular text badge with an arrow, a paragraph with sparkle glyphs, the name 'Ariana Gold.' and a dark moody portrait inside a thick green frame.
whatItMeans: Confident and clean; a green keyword and frame give a minimal portfolio a fresh signature.
techniques: Colour the key words of a light headline green.
Add a circular rotating text badge.
Frame a dark portrait with a thick coloured border.

vocabulary.definition: Text set on a ring around an arrow.
A thick coloured border around a photo.
A switch between light and dark mode.
